description_json.name: VowelConsonantInterleaveSimple
description_json.idea: To maximize the model's reasoning ability and prevent garbled outputs, we use a simple, non-mathematical structural permutation. Each word is split into two halves: the first half of the characters, and the second half of the characters. The ciphertext for each word is formed by taking the first half of the word, followed by a hyphen '-', followed by the second half of the word reversed. If a word has an odd number of characters, the middle character belongs to the first half. Spaces, punctuation, and digits are left completely unchanged and are not split.
description_json.encrypt_rules: For each word (defined as a sequence of alphabetic characters): 1. Find its length L. 2. Split the word into two parts: Part 1 contains the first ceil(L/2) characters. Part 2 contains the remaining characters. 3. Reverse Part 2. 4. The encrypted word is Part 1, followed by a hyphen '-', followed by the reversed Part 2. Non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) are left completely unchanged and are not modified.
description_json.decrypt_rules: For each word containing a hyphen '-': 1. Split the word at the hyphen into Part 1 and Part 2. 2. Reverse Part 2. 3. Combine Part 1 and the reversed Part 2 to reconstruct the original word. Non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) are left completely unchanged.
